sloka: तस्मिन् प्रवृद्धोत्तमसानुवृक्षे शृङ्गे विकीर्णे पतिते पृथिव्याम् ।महाहिकल्पं शरमन्तकाभं समाददे राक्षसलोकनाथः ।। ६.५९.३८ ।।।।
transliteration: tasmin pravṛddhottamasānuvṛkṣe śṛṅge vikīrṇe patite pṛthivyām ।mahāhikalpaṁ śaramantakābhaṁ samādade rākṣasalokanāthaḥ ।। 6.59.38 ।।।।

translations.english: After that slope covered with excellent trees had fallen on the ground and broken, Ravana got readied with an arrow as if for arranging destruction like the spirit of death.
